name: Fill missing Wix SEO titles and meta descriptions with Gemini

parameters.content:
## Fill missing Wix SEO titles and meta descriptions with Gemini

Wix writes a title like "Page Name | My Site" for every page, product and blog post,
and leaves the meta description empty. Google then invents its own snippet.

This workflow finds every item with no real SEO tags, writes a title and meta
description from the page's own content, and saves them back. It fills gaps only, so
anything you wrote by hand stays untouched.

### How it works

1. Reads the SEO tags on your pages, blog posts and store products.
2. Keeps only the items Wix reports as having no custom tags, so no AI quota is spent finding them.
3. Pulls real product copy, options and prices for product pages.
4. Sends the batch to Gemini once, using a strict JSON schema.
5. Checks every suggestion for length, duplicates, emoji and shouting.
6. Saves the survivors, then reports what changed and what was rejected.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a Wix API key with View SEO Settings, Manage SEO Settings and Read Products
- [ ] Add it as Header Auth named `Authorization` on the three Wix HTTP nodes
- [ ] Add your Gemini key as Header Auth named `x-goog-api-key` on the Gemini node only
- [ ] Paste your Wix site ID into Set Wix Configuration
- [ ] Run once with `dry_run` true, read the report, then set it to false

### Customization

Set Wix Configuration holds the item types, batch size and character limits. To change
the tone of the copy, edit the numbered rules in Create Gemini API Request.

**Note:** page and blog tags save to the site draft, so publish in the Wix editor to
take them live. Store products go live straight away.

## Schedule and settings

Runs weekly, then sets the Wix site, item types, brand name, batch size, character limits and dry-run mode that every later step reads.

## Read the SEO tags from Wix

Expands the configured item types into one row each, fetches the current SEO tags per type, and turns a bad response into a readable error instead of a silent failure.

## Find the gaps

Keeps items Wix reports as having no custom tags, skipping anything noindex or already written by hand. Wix does this filtering, so no AI quota is spent finding them. When nothing needs doing, the run explains why instead of returning an empty result.

## Add the product copy

Pulls real descriptions, info sections, options and price range from the Wix Stores catalog so product pages get specific copy instead of a guess from the page name.

## Write and check the copy

One Gemini call covers the whole batch. Every suggestion is then checked for length, duplicates, emoji and shouting, and anything that fails is dropped with a reason.

## Save back to Wix

Dry run stops here and reports. Otherwise each item is patched individually and the real HTTP status of every write is reported, because the Wix bulk endpoint returns successes it never performed.
